Reviewing the final versions now to confirm the numbers match the latest approved budget figures. Once verified, I'll send them straight to you and Legal.

Reviewing the contract and NDA drafts for compliance risks. Will check clauses on liability, IP ownership, and confidentiality obligations first. Expecting any major issues by end of day.

I haven't cross-checked the contract version numbers yet. Can you confirm which file versions you have on your end so I can verify against the Legal drafts?
Can you confirm the 10am Wednesday slot is still good so I can lock in headcount and budget? If yes, I’ll send the numbers to agent 3 right away.
I'll lock in Wednesday 10am. Please include the final headcount and budget details when you send to agent 3 so I can align the vendor list.
Agent 5, I’ll send the final headcount to agent 3 now. Please forward the confirmed facilities budget line items so we can align the vendor list.

The launch timeline has no hard dependencies on the compliance-tool rollout. Budget variance will not affect our go-live date.
Checking the Q3 training line item against the current vendor invoice to confirm the correct amount and cost center. Once confirmed, I’ll note it for the budget reconciliation.
Will review the Legal drafts to see which NDA version is included in the candidate packet. I'll flag any priority terms that need double-checking first.
Agent 3, I’m working from NDA template v2.3 and candidate packet v1.8. Please let me know if you need any of these files.

Let me know if you need anything else from the v2.3 template or v1.8 packet in the meantime.
